utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard Quinn’s spreading the word, so I can quietly mention the repair drive to a few people I pass today. If anyone offers tools, I’ll send their name and location to Sam.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — that helps. Please send Sam the names and any tools offered, and remind folks to bring repair items to the hall tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I can do that quietly. I’ll mention the hall tomorrow and pass any tool offers along to Sam.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Kira, it’s locked in—I’ll have the first names and item list ready for Rosa by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just to confirm, you’ll have the first names and item list to Rosa by Friday, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Kira—still locked in for Friday, with the first names and item list going to Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, I’m still free Saturday and can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’s so kind, but the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. If you’re still free then, could you help check people in and point them to the right repair table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the update, Rosa—yes, I can do Sunday at the community center. I’ll help check folks in and direct them to the right repair table.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, I’m keeping the repair drive list; Gus is bringing tools at 9 Saturday, and I’m checking lamps, chairs, and small appliances now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — send me the reported repairs when you’ve got them, and flag anything urgent or already covered so I can sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Hana; I’ll send you the current list once I finish checking it this afternoon, with urgent items and anything already covered clearly marked.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate you marking the community room and adding the item guidelines. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—I’ve got it logged for the community room Saturday 10 to 2, with small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing accepted and no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Opal — that matches our plan, and I’ll let you know right away if any details change before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren—quick version, I’m in for one repair drive slot and can do an after-school pickup if Faye sends the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo—repair drive slot and after-school pickup if Faye sends the exact time. I’ll jot that down before it slips right out of my head.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Oren—appreciate it. Just send the exact pickup time when Faye has it, and I’ll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just joining the repair drive thread now, Ira, so I’m checking with Hana on the triage list before I claim anything. If you’ve heard which gaps are still biggest, send them my way and I’ll help sort what’s easiest to cover.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — so far I’ve only heard small appliances are being collected and Oren’s on sorting and labeling, but I’ll send you the confirmed gaps as soon as Mina or Hana pins them down.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — that helps. I’ll wait for Mina or Hana’s confirmed gaps, then I’ll compare them with what Oren’s already covering so we don’t duplicate work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, have you told Eli what you can help with for the repair drive, and do you know any specific items that still need fixing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet, but I can tell Eli I’m helping spread the word and keep things organized. So far I only know we’re collecting broken small appliances, and I’ll pass along the rest once you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please tell Eli today that you’re helping with outreach and organization, and ask him for the current broken-item list before you spread anything so we don’t duplicate work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could we set up a clear drop-off table with labels so nothing gets mixed up before lunch?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — a labeled drop-off table sounds perfect, and I can make sure it’s set up before lunch so everything stays sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Jules—that eases my mind. Could we also put a clipboard there so each item gets a name and note attached before sorting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Tess, I’m still getting repair drive updates second-hand, and Dane pointed me toward Hana for the real list—have you heard what gaps are still biggest?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m hearing the biggest gaps are still practical ones—space to sort things, clipboards or some way to track repairs, and a couple steady hands for drop-offs. I’m asking around today, and I’ll compare notes with Hana’s list when I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks Tess—I’ll hold off on repeating it as definite until Hana confirms, but I can mention sorting space and drop-off help as likely needs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — the drive is Saturday 10 to 2, so if you can bring basic tools, gloves, and any spare screws or patch supplies, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll bring basic tools, gloves, and some spare screws and patch supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll try to be there before 9 and text if I get turned around again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be out front a little before 9 with the toolbox and cords. Text me if you get turned around again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks Gus — I’ll look for you out front before 9 and I’ll bring my box of busted cords too, if I remember it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane, quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we’re starting with safety fixes first. If you’re able, I’d love your help checking in with Cleo on the needs list before Friday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m just catching up, but I can check in with Cleo and help sort the needs list before Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — that would be a big help. Please check in with Cleo and keep the safety fixes at the top of the list for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo—I’m in for one repair-drive slot and can cover an after-school pickup window if Faye sends the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo—take one slot after lunch at the hall. I’ll have Faye send you the pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, after lunch at the hall works for me—just send the pickup time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in, Nell — I can bring my toolbox and a few extension cords if that helps. Just tell me where you want them dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—that sounds really helpful. I’m checking with Hana for the current list, so I’ll confirm the drop-off spot before you haul anything over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just send me the spot when you have it, and I’ll bring the toolbox and cords over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ira, I’m keeping the repair drive list orderly: Gus is bringing tools at 9 Saturday, and I’m still confirming which lamps, chairs, and small appliances need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that helps—I’ll keep asking around for any other items and helpers while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Faye, are you actually available to help with the repair drive on Saturday? I need a firm yes before I count on you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, you can count me in for Saturday—I can help during the 10 to 2 repair drive, as long as I can step out if pickup timing comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm: that’s a yes for Saturday, even with the pickup caveat?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Pia, I’m still collecting repair requests and noting the supplies each one needs, so Rosa can start matching volunteers by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s helpful, Cleo—do you want people to leave repair items at the hall entrance, and who’s keeping the request list updated until Friday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not at the hall entrance yet, please—have folks bring the details to me or send them along, and I’ll keep the request list updated through Friday for Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll do that, Sam. I’ll mention it quietly today and send you any tool offers with names and locations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. Send me any tool offers with names and locations, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Sam. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along only the clear offers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Opal! I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room. Want me to pass along anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please mention it’s in the community room from 10 to 2, and we’re taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing—just no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Opal — I’ll pass along Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, with small appliances, lamps, bikes, and torn clothing welcome, but no hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, Eli’s keeping the list, but do you know any specific items that still need fixing or anyone else who’s already promised to help?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I know folks still need tools and spare hands, but I don’t have Eli’s specific fix-list yet; I’ve promised Hana I’ll gather the reported repairs and best spot, so I’ll check with Eli and loop you in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. Please check with Eli and send me the specific broken items plus who’s already helping so we don’t overlap.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room—are you able to help with intake or repairs?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Mara—I can help with intake, and I’ll bring a couple clipboards if I can round them up. I’ve also been asking around about drop-off help, so I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess, intake would be a huge help, and clipboards would be perfect if you find them. Please do let me know what you hear about drop-off help, since Gus is bringing tools and extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m checking in quietly where I can—Rosa said safety fixes come first, and Cleo’s gathering names and supplies by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks, Rey. I think the drive’s tomorrow at the hall, with drop-off first and sorting after lunch, so safety fixes first sounds right to me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah—I’ll make sure my labeled tools get dropped off early, then check with Cleo so they go toward the safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Oren, before we start assigning anything, can you send me the reported repairs and note which ones seem urgent or already have volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh goodness, Hana, I don’t think I have that repair list in front of me—I’m only written down for Saturday morning sorting and labeling small appliances, but I can help mark urgency once you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for the repair list from Jules or Faye, then I’ll send you the small-appliance items so you can help mark anything urgent for Saturday morning.
